C1_vitaminc_unsupported_claim_negative_t.key: (page, claim) against the VitaminC train split - the row the lane took the negative from
C1_vitaminc_unsupported_claim_negative_t.reading: REFUTES negatives are CONTRADICTED by the pool, not absent from it; under the shipped binary support predicate both REFUTES and NOT ENOUGH INFO are correctly 0, so the label stays commensurable - but the REFUTES share is the part of the negative leg that is lexically near-identical to a supported claim

C1_minicheck_unsupported_claim_negative.label_predicate: MiniCheck ships a binary supported / not-supported label produced by a GPT-4 entailment filter; the negative document is generated to NOT support the claim. The predicate is support

C6_mean_label_oracle.definition: score each row by the MEAN label the rest of the assembled mix attaches to its exact claim string; within-pair accuracy of that score is the memorisation channel

C6_claim_evidence_association_oracle.definition: for each VitaminC-sourced row, does the pooled chunk CONTAIN, verbatim, an evidence string that the mix's own `vitaminc` member pairs with this exact claim - and at which label. This is a feature keyed purely on a training association, computable without reading the claim's meaning
C6_claim_evidence_association_oracle.scope: VitaminC-sourced rows only (11,998 of 21,408); MiniCheck is not a mix member, so no such association exists for its rows

C8_duplication_detail.note: a claim repeated with one label only is directly memorisable within the member; a claim repeated with both labels is not
